verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine. A built-in assistant, such as a docs or ops assistant, is a plausible ask for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only serving primitives: tool calling, reasoning parsers and an OpenAI-compatible API. These are developer building blocks for constructing agents, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
